# WES oncoplot for ER+ pILC Bionano subgroup

This Rmd generates a ComplexHeatmap-style oncoplot for the **10 ER+ pILC samples with Bionano/OGM data**, using the **same breast/cancer-relevant WES gene panel** used for the grant-focused WES/IMPACT comparison.

Key points:

1. WES calls are read from the combined MAF.
2. The MAF is subset to the 10 ER+ Bionano/OGM samples.
3. The plot columns are restricted to WES-available samples within this subgroup.
4. Genes shown are the WES breast/cancer gene panel genes mutated in the WES subgroup.
5. Bottom annotations use the same ComplexHeatmap style as the functional-category plot:
   - Tumor cellularity (%)
   - Pleomorphic component (%)
   - TILs (%)
   - Grade
6. Sample names are hidden.
7. Cell size is reduced using `cell_size_mm <- 3.0`.

```{r colors}
# ============================================================
# Colors: same style as previous functional-category plot
# ============================================================

grade_cols <- c(
  "Grade I" = "#A6CEE3",
  "Grade II" = "#33A02C",
  "Grade III" = "#1F78B4",
  "Cell type not determined" = "#E31A1C",
  "Unknown" = "#BDBDBD"
)

base_mutation_colors <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation"       = "#1F77B4",
  "Nonsense_Mutation"       = "#D62728",
  "Frame_Shift_Del"         = "#9467BD",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins"         = "#8C564B",
  "In_Frame_Del"            = "#2CA02C",
  "In_Frame_Ins"            = "#17BECF",
  "Splice_Site"             = "#FF7F0E",
  "Translation_Start_Site"  = "#E377C2",
  "Nonstop_Mutation"        = "#BCBD22",
  "Start_Codon_Del"         = "#AEC7E8",
  "Start_Codon_Ins"         = "#98DF8A",
  "Stop_Codon_Del"          = "#FFBB78",
  "Stop_Codon_Ins"          = "#C5B0D5",
  "Multi_Hit"               = "#000000"
)

get_mutation_colors <- function(types) {
  types <- unique(types)
  types <- types[!is.na(types) & types != ""]

  known <- intersect(types, names(base_mutation_colors))
  missing <- setdiff(types, names(base_mutation_colors))

  cols <- base_mutation_colors[known]

  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    extra_cols <- hcl.colors(length(missing), palette = "Dark 3")
    names(extra_cols) <- missing
    cols <- c(cols, extra_cols)
  }

  cols[types]
}
```

```{r helper-functions}
# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================

clean_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  # MAF IDs may be TP05-232_T, TP05-232_Tumor, or TP05-232-T.
  x <- sub("_Tumor$", "", x)
  x <- sub("_T$", "", x)
  x <- sub("-T$", "", x)
  x <- sub("\\.T$", "", x)

  x
}

parse_percent_value <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan")] <- NA_character_

  is_less_than <- grepl("^<", x)

  val <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", x))
  )

  # Same style as previous script: use half the threshold for < values.
  val[is_less_than & !is.na(val)] <- val[is_less_than & !is.na(val)] / 2

  return(val)
}

clean_grade_status <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)

  out <- x
  out[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan") | is.na(x)] <- "Unknown"

  return(out)
}

safe_file_name <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("_+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("^_|_$", "", x)
  x
}
```

# 1. Read and subset WES combined MAF

```{r read-and-subset-maf}
# ============================================================
# Read existing combined MAF
# ============================================================

if (!file.exists(combined_maf_file)) {
  stop("Combined MAF file does not exist: ", combined_maf_file)
}

combined_maf <- fread(
  combined_maf_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  data.table = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE,
  quote = ""
)

cat("Combined MAF dimensions:\n")
print(dim(combined_maf))

required_maf_cols <- c(
  "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
  "Hugo_Symbol",
  "Variant_Classification"
)

missing_maf_cols <- setdiff(required_maf_cols, colnames(combined_maf))

if (length(missing_maf_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns in combined MAF: ", paste(missing_maf_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

combined_maf[, Tumor_Sample_Barcode := trimws(as.character(Tumor_Sample_Barcode))]
combined_maf[, Hugo_Symbol := trimws(as.character(Hugo_Symbol))]
combined_maf[, Variant_Classification := trimws(as.character(Variant_Classification))]
combined_maf[, Sample_clean := clean_sample(Tumor_Sample_Barcode)]

# Non-silent / protein-altering classes commonly used for MAF summaries.
nonsyn_classes <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation",
  "Nonsense_Mutation",
  "Frame_Shift_Del",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins",
  "In_Frame_Del",
  "In_Frame_Ins",
  "Splice_Site",
  "Translation_Start_Site",
  "Nonstop_Mutation",
  "Start_Codon_Del",
  "Start_Codon_Ins",
  "Stop_Codon_Del",
  "Stop_Codon_Ins"
)

# Subset to the 10 ER+ Bionano samples.
combined_maf_grant_all <- combined_maf[Sample_clean %in% grant_samples_10]

# Keep non-silent/protein-altering variants for the oncoplot.
combined_maf_grant <- combined_maf_grant_all[Variant_Classification %in% nonsyn_classes]

# Use clean sample names downstream.
combined_maf_grant[, Tumor_Sample_Barcode := Sample_clean]
combined_maf_grant_all[, Tumor_Sample_Barcode := Sample_clean]

cat("\nRows in ER+ Bionano WES subgroup MAF, all variant classes:\n")
print(nrow(combined_maf_grant_all))

cat("\nRows in ER+ Bionano WES subgroup MAF, non-synonymous/protein-altering only:\n")
print(nrow(combined_maf_grant))

# WES-available samples are samples present in the subgroup non-synonymous MAF.
# This is expected to be 8/10 for the current subgroup.
wes_samples_available <- grant_samples_10[
  grant_samples_10 %in% unique(combined_maf_grant$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
]

wes_sample_check <- data.table(
  Sample = grant_samples_10,
  Present_in_WES_MAF = grant_samples_10 %in% unique(combined_maf_grant_all$Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
  Has_non_synonymous_WES_call = grant_samples_10 %in% unique(combined_maf_grant$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
)

cat("\n========== WES availability among 10 ER+ Bionano samples ==========\n")
print(wes_sample_check)

cat("\nWES-available samples to show in oncoplot:\n")
print(wes_samples_available)
cat("Number of WES-available samples:", length(wes_samples_available), "\n\n")

fwrite(
  wes_sample_check,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_n10_WES_sample_availability.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

if (nrow(combined_maf_grant) == 0) {
  stop("No non-synonymous WES MAF rows found for the 10 ER+ Bionano samples. Check sample names.")
}

# Save subgroup MAF used by maftools/summary tables.
fwrite(
  combined_maf_grant,
  file = grant_maf_file,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

cat("\nSaved subgroup WES MAF:\n")
cat(grant_maf_file, "\n")
```

# 3. Select WES-panel genes and create cell-level mutation matrix

```{r create-mutation-matrix}
# Keep only mutation calls in the WES breast/cancer gene panel.
wes_panel <- combined_maf_grant[Hugo_Symbol %in% breast_genes]

if (nrow(wes_panel) == 0) {
  stop("No WES mutations in the selected breast/cancer gene panel.")
}

# Preserve WES-panel gene order, but only plot genes mutated by WES in this subgroup.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Order genes by alteration frequency: high to low
# Each sample-gene pair is counted once, even if there are
# multiple variants in the same gene/sample cell.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gene_order_dt <- wes_panel[
  ,
  .(
    altered_samples = uniqueN(Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
    total_variants = .N
  ),
  by = Hugo_Symbol
]

# Keep only genes from the selected breast/WES panel
gene_order_dt <- gene_order_dt[Hugo_Symbol %in% breast_genes]

# Use original panel order only as a tie-breaker
gene_order_dt[, panel_order := match(Hugo_Symbol, breast_genes)]

# Sort genes:
# 1. highest altered sample count
# 2. highest total variant count
# 3. original breast panel order
gene_order_dt <- gene_order_dt[
  order(-altered_samples, -total_variants, panel_order)
]

plot_genes <- gene_order_dt$Hugo_Symbol
plot_samples <- wes_samples_available

cat("Genes used for WES oncoplot ordered by alteration frequency, high to low:\n")
print(gene_order_dt)

cat("Samples used for WES oncoplot:\n")
print(plot_samples)

# Add optional columns if missing.
for (cc in c("HGVSp_Short", "HGVSp", "HGVSc")) {
  if (!cc %in% colnames(wes_panel)) {
    wes_panel[, (cc) := NA_character_]
  }
}

# Cell-level summary:
# Multi_Hit = >1 variant row in same sample + gene cell.
cell_dt <- wes_panel[
  ,
  .(
    n_variants = .N,
    Display = ifelse(.N > 1, "Multi_Hit", as.character(Variant_Classification[1])),
    Variant_Classification_List = paste(unique(Variant_Classification), collapse = ";"),
    HGVSp_Short_List = paste(unique(na.omit(HGVSp_Short)), collapse = ";"),
    HGVSp_List = paste(unique(na.omit(HGVSp)), collapse = ";"),
    HGVSc_List = paste(unique(na.omit(HGVSc)), collapse = ";")
  ),
  by = .(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Hugo_Symbol)
]

# Save cell-level table.
fwrite(
  cell_dt,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_panel_cell_level_oncoplot_table.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# Build mutation matrix.
mut_mat <- matrix(
  "",
  nrow = length(plot_genes),
  ncol = length(plot_samples),
  dimnames = list(plot_genes, plot_samples)
)

for (ii in seq_len(nrow(cell_dt))) {
  g <- cell_dt$Hugo_Symbol[ii]
  s <- cell_dt$Tumor_Sample_Barcode[ii]

  if (g %in% rownames(mut_mat) && s %in% colnames(mut_mat)) {
    mut_mat[g, s] <- cell_dt$Display[ii]
  }
}

plot_mat <- mut_mat
plot_mat[plot_mat == ""] <- NA_character_

cat("\nMutation matrix dimensions:\n")
print(dim(mut_mat))

cat("\nSamples with WES data but no mutation in selected WES-panel genes:\n")
print(setdiff(plot_samples, unique(cell_dt$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)))
```

# 4. Read clinical annotation and build bottom tracks

```{r read-clinical}
cat("Reading clinical annotation file:\n", clinical_file, "\n\n")

clinical_dt <- fread(
  clinical_file,
  sep = ",",
  header = TRUE,
  data.table = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE,
  na.strings = c("", "NA", "NaN", "N/A")
)

required_clin_cols <- c(
  "Sample",
  "tumor_cellularity (%)",
  "pleomorphic_invasive_compoent_cellularity (%)",
  "TILs (%)",
  "Grade/Differentiation-Desc"
)

missing_clin_cols <- setdiff(required_clin_cols, colnames(clinical_dt))

if (length(missing_clin_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required clinical columns: ", paste(missing_clin_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

clinical_dt[, Sample_key := clean_sample(Sample)]
clinical_dt[, tumor_cellularity_pct := parse_percent_value(`tumor_cellularity (%)`)]
clinical_dt[, pleomorphic_component_cellularity_pct := parse_percent_value(`pleomorphic_invasive_compoent_cellularity (%)`)]
clinical_dt[, TILs_pct := parse_percent_value(`TILs (%)`)]
clinical_dt[, Grade_clean := clean_grade_status(`Grade/Differentiation-Desc`)]

clinical_plot_dt <- unique(
  clinical_dt[
    ,
    .(
      Sample_key,
      tumor_cellularity_pct,
      pleomorphic_component_cellularity_pct,
      TILs_pct,
      Grade_clean
    )
  ],
  by = "Sample_key"
)

sample_clin_dt <- data.table(
  Tumor_Sample_Barcode = plot_samples,
  Sample_key = clean_sample(plot_samples)
)

sample_clin_dt <- merge(
  sample_clin_dt,
  clinical_plot_dt,
  by = "Sample_key",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

sample_clin_dt <- sample_clin_dt[
  match(plot_samples, Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
]

sample_clin_dt[, Column_Index := seq_len(.N)]

setcolorder(
  sample_clin_dt,
  c(
    "Column_Index",
    "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
    "Sample_key",
    setdiff(
      colnames(sample_clin_dt),
      c("Column_Index", "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Sample_key")
    )
  )
)

cat("\nClinical annotation in plot sample order:\n")
print(sample_clin_dt)

fwrite(
  sample_clin_dt,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_panel_sample_order_and_clinical_annotation.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

clinical_anno_df <- data.frame(
  `Tumor cell. (%)` = sample_clin_dt$tumor_cellularity_pct,
  `Pleomorphic (%)` = sample_clin_dt$pleomorphic_component_cellularity_pct,
  `TILs (%)` = sample_clin_dt$TILs_pct,
  Grade = sample_clin_dt$Grade_clean,
  check.names = FALSE
)

rownames(clinical_anno_df) <- plot_samples

# Add colors for any grade level not in the fixed palette.
observed_grade_levels <- unique(na.omit(clinical_anno_df$Grade))
observed_grade_levels <- observed_grade_levels[observed_grade_levels != ""]

missing_grade_levels <- setdiff(observed_grade_levels, names(grade_cols))

grade_cols_local <- grade_cols

if (length(missing_grade_levels) > 0) {
  extra_grade_cols <- hcl.colors(length(missing_grade_levels), palette = "Dark 3")
  names(extra_grade_cols) <- missing_grade_levels
  grade_cols_local <- c(grade_cols_local, extra_grade_cols)
}

clinical_anno_cols <- list(
  `Tumor cell. (%)` = colorRamp2(
    c(0, 50, 100),
    c("#F7FBFF", "#6BAED6", "#08306B")
  ),
  `Pleomorphic (%)` = colorRamp2(
    c(0, 50, 100),
    c("#F7FCF5", "#74C476", "#00441B")
  ),
  `TILs (%)` = colorRamp2(
    c(0, 30, 100),
    c("#FFF5F0", "#FB6A4A", "#67000D")
  ),
  Grade = grade_cols_local
)

if (length(setdiff(colnames(clinical_anno_df), names(clinical_anno_cols))) > 0) {
  stop("Clinical annotation dataframe and color list names do not match.")
}
```

# 5. Build ComplexHeatmap WES oncoplot

```{r build-complexheatmap}
# ============================================================
# Top stacked barplot: number of mutation rows per sample
# within the selected WES-panel calls.
# ============================================================

sample_class_dt <- wes_panel[
  ,
  .N,
  by = .(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Variant_Classification)
]

sample_class_mat_dt <- dcast(
  sample_class_dt,
  Tumor_Sample_Barcode ~ Variant_Classification,
  value.var = "N",
  fill = 0
)

sample_class_mat_dt <- merge(
  data.table(Tumor_Sample_Barcode = plot_samples),
  sample_class_mat_dt,
  by = "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

sample_class_mat_dt <- sample_class_mat_dt[
  match(plot_samples, Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
]

sample_class_cols <- setdiff(colnames(sample_class_mat_dt), "Tumor_Sample_Barcode")

if (length(sample_class_cols) == 0) {

  sample_class_mat <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = length(plot_samples),
    ncol = 1,
    dimnames = list(plot_samples, "No_mutation")
  )

} else {

  for (cc in sample_class_cols) {
    sample_class_mat_dt[is.na(get(cc)), (cc) := 0]
  }

  sample_class_mat <- as.matrix(sample_class_mat_dt[, ..sample_class_cols])
  rownames(sample_class_mat) <- sample_class_mat_dt$Tumor_Sample_Barcode
}

# ============================================================
# Right stacked barplot: altered samples per gene by mutation class.
# ============================================================

gene_class_dt <- cell_dt[
  ,
  .N,
  by = .(Hugo_Symbol, Display)
]

gene_class_mat_dt <- dcast(
  gene_class_dt,
  Hugo_Symbol ~ Display,
  value.var = "N",
  fill = 0
)

gene_class_mat_dt <- merge(
  data.table(Hugo_Symbol = plot_genes),
  gene_class_mat_dt,
  by = "Hugo_Symbol",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

gene_class_mat_dt <- gene_class_mat_dt[
  match(plot_genes, Hugo_Symbol)
]

gene_class_cols <- setdiff(colnames(gene_class_mat_dt), "Hugo_Symbol")

if (length(gene_class_cols) == 0) {

  gene_class_mat <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = length(plot_genes),
    ncol = 1,
    dimnames = list(plot_genes, "No_mutation")
  )

} else {

  for (cc in gene_class_cols) {
    gene_class_mat_dt[is.na(get(cc)), (cc) := 0]
  }

  gene_class_mat <- as.matrix(gene_class_mat_dt[, ..gene_class_cols])
  rownames(gene_class_mat) <- gene_class_mat_dt$Hugo_Symbol
}

gene_mutated_sample_counts <- rowSums(mut_mat != "")
gene_mutated_sample_pct <- round(100 * gene_mutated_sample_counts / ncol(mut_mat))

# ============================================================
# Mutation colors for heatmap and stacked barplots.
# ============================================================

mut_types_heatmap <- sort(unique(na.omit(as.vector(plot_mat))))
sample_bar_classes <- colnames(sample_class_mat)
row_bar_classes <- colnames(gene_class_mat)

all_mutation_types_for_plot <- sort(unique(c(
  mut_types_heatmap,
  sample_bar_classes,
  row_bar_classes
)))

all_mutation_types_for_plot <- setdiff(all_mutation_types_for_plot, "No_mutation")

mutation_colors <- get_mutation_colors(all_mutation_types_for_plot)

sample_bar_colors <- mutation_colors[sample_bar_classes]
sample_bar_colors[is.na(sample_bar_colors)] <- "grey50"

row_bar_colors <- mutation_colors[row_bar_classes]
row_bar_colors[is.na(row_bar_colors)] <- "grey50"

# ============================================================
# Annotations
# ============================================================

top_bar_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  `Mutations per sample` = anno_barplot(
    sample_class_mat,
    gp = gpar(fill = sample_bar_colors, col = NA),
    border = FALSE,
    bar_width = 0.95,
    height = unit(1.6, "cm"),
    axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 7))
  ),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
)

bottom_clin_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  ` ` = anno_empty(
    height = unit(0.8, "mm"),
    border = FALSE
  ),
  df = clinical_anno_df,
  col = clinical_anno_cols,
  na_col = "grey90",
  which = "column",
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  annotation_name_rot = 0,
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  simple_anno_size = unit(0.22, "cm"),
  gap = unit(c(2.0, rep(0.8, ncol(clinical_anno_df) - 1)), "mm"),
  show_annotation_name = c(
    ` ` = FALSE,
    `Tumor cell. (%)` = TRUE,
    `Pleomorphic (%)` = TRUE,
    `TILs (%)` = TRUE,
    Grade = TRUE
  ),
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    `Tumor cell. (%)` = list(title = "Tumor cell. (%)"),
    `Pleomorphic (%)` = list(title = "Pleomorphic (%)"),
    `TILs (%)` = list(title = "TILs (%)"),
    Grade = list(title = "Grade")
  )
)

right_bar_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  `Altered samples by class` = anno_barplot(
    gene_class_mat,
    gp = gpar(fill = row_bar_colors, col = NA),
    border = FALSE,
    bar_width = 0.85,
    axis = TRUE,
    axis_param = list(
      gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
      side = "bottom"
    )
  ),
  `% altered` = anno_text(
    paste0(gene_mutated_sample_pct, "%"),
    gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    just = "left",
    location = 0
  ),
  width = unit(3.4, "cm"),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# Reduced square cell size
# ============================================================

cell_size_mm <- 9.0

heatmap_body_width_mm <- max(25, cell_size_mm * ncol(mut_mat))
heatmap_body_height_mm <- max(28, cell_size_mm * nrow(mut_mat))

plot_width <- max(10.5, min(16, heatmap_body_width_mm / 25.4 + 7.8))
plot_height <- max(7.5, min(13, heatmap_body_height_mm / 25.4 + 4.8))

cat("\nCell size in mm:", cell_size_mm, "\n")
cat("Heatmap body width mm:", heatmap_body_width_mm, "\n")
cat("Heatmap body height mm:", heatmap_body_height_mm, "\n")
cat("PDF/PNG width inches:", plot_width, "\n")
cat("PDF/PNG height inches:", plot_height, "\n")

ht <- Heatmap(
  plot_mat,
  name = "Mutation type",
  col = mutation_colors,
  na_col = "grey80",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_order = plot_genes,
  column_order = plot_samples,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_names_side = "left",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "italic"),
  column_title = paste0(
    "ER+ pILC Bionano Subgroup: WES mutations in WES gene panel",
    " | genes: ", nrow(mut_mat),
    " | samples: ", ncol(mut_mat)
  ),
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  width = unit(heatmap_body_width_mm, "mm"),
  height = unit(heatmap_body_height_mm, "mm"),
  rect_gp = gpar(type = "none"),
  top_annotation = top_bar_ha,
  bottom_annotation = bottom_clin_ha,
  right_annotation = right_bar_ha,
  column_gap = unit(0.05, "mm"),
  row_gap = unit(0.05, "mm"),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Mutation type",
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7)
  ),
  layer_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {

    grid.rect(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      width = width * 0.995,
      height = height * 0.995,
      gp = gpar(fill = "grey80", col = "white", lwd = 0.10)
    )

    for (kk in seq_along(x)) {

      this_mut <- mut_mat[i[kk], j[kk]]

      if (!is.na(this_mut) && this_mut != "") {
        grid.rect(
          x = x[kk],
          y = y[kk],
          width = width[kk] * 0.94,
          height = height[kk] * 0.94,
          gp = gpar(fill = mutation_colors[this_mut], col = NA)
        )
      }
    }
  }
)
```

# 6. Draw and save WES ComplexHeatmap oncoplot

```{r save-plot, fig.width=10.5, fig.height=7.5}
# Display in notebook.
draw(
  ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  merge_legends = FALSE,
  padding = unit(c(4, 25, 6, 4), "mm")
)

pdf_file <- file.path(
  plot_dir,
  "ERpos_Bionano_WES_oncoplot_WES_gene_panel_ComplexHeatmap_clinical_annotation_small_cells.pdf"
)

png_file <- file.path(
  plot_dir,
  "ERpos_Bionano_WES_oncoplot_WES_gene_panel_ComplexHeatmap_clinical_annotation_small_cells.png"
)

pdf(pdf_file, width = plot_width, height = plot_height, bg = "white")

draw(
  ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  merge_legends = FALSE,
  padding = unit(c(4, 25, 6, 4), "mm")
)

dev.off()

if (isTRUE(SAVE_PNG)) {

  png(
    filename = png_file,
    width = plot_width,
    height = plot_height,
    units = "in",
    res = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )

  draw(
    ht,
    heatmap_legend_side = "right",
    annotation_legend_side = "right",
    merge_legends = FALSE,
    padding = unit(c(4, 25, 6, 4), "mm")
  )

  dev.off()

} else {
  png_file <- NA_character_
}

cat("Saved:\n")
cat("  ", pdf_file, "\n")
if (!is.na(png_file)) {
  cat("  ", png_file, "\n")
}
cat("  ", file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_panel_sample_order_and_clinical_annotation.tsv"), "\n")
cat("  ", file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_panel_cell_level_oncoplot_table.tsv"), "\n")
```
